tex_content.label: prop:homotopic-maps-pairs
tex_content.html:
Proposition
[If two maps $f,g:(X,A)\to (Y,B)$ are homotopic through maps of pairs $(X,A)\to (Y,B)$, then $f_* = g_*:H_n(X,A)\to H_n(Y,B)$] ↗ def:homotopy ↗ thm:homotopic-maps-induce-same-homology-map 1. ch2:2.19\group Singular Homology

Homotopic maps of pairs induce the same homomorphism on relative homology.
Proof

\sketch The prism operator preserves the subcomplex of chains in $A$ and therefore descends to relative chains, where $\partial P+P\partial =g_\sharp -f_\sharp $.

□

For $Z\subset A\subset X$, the long exact sequence of the triple is \[ \cdots \to H_n(A,Z)\to H_n(X,Z)\to H_n(X,A)\to H_{n-1}(A,Z)\to \cdots . \]
